note: Emergency numbers served by GET /hotlines. A number is listed only if the official government page in source_url showed it, and source_quote is that page's wording, copied verbatim on the `checked` date. Numbers that only news sites gave (Chennai's 1913, NDMA's 1078, Kerala's 1077) are left out. Re-check every entry, and the date, before a release. `regions` keys are data/cities.json region names; `cities` keys are its city keys. `name` and `note` are English keys into ui-strings/ui_strings.json.
